Sagar university seeks a contract curator for its archaeology department

Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is offering one curator post at Rs 40,000 a month, on a contract of up to 12 months. Online applications close on 30 November 2026.

Talaash Heritage desk · Published 6 November 2026

Where
Sagar, Madhya Pradesh
Apply by
30 November 2026

Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya in Sagar, Madhya Pradesh, has advertised one post of Curator in its Department of Ancient Indian History, Culture and Archaeology. The notice, Advertisement No. R/2026/NTC-01, is dated 1 November 2026, and the post is unreserved.

The job is on contract for no more than 12 months and pays Rs 40,000 a month. The university says the engagement is temporary and gives no right to regular employment.

There are two routes in. One is a master's degree with 55 per cent marks in Museology or History of Art. The other is a master's degree with 55 per cent marks in a subject such as Ancient Indian History, Sanskrit, Pali, Prakrit, Persian, Arabic, Archaeology, Anthropology or Fine Arts, together with a diploma or certificate in Museology from a recognised institution.

Either route also needs three years' experience in a museum of national or regional importance under the Central, State or Union Territory government, including a year of practical work on collecting, conserving and exhibiting art objects. The upper age limit is 40, with relaxations under Government of India or UGC policy. Age, qualifications and experience are all counted as of the last date for applying.

The fee is Rs 1,000 for General, OBC and EWS candidates and Rs 500 for SC, ST, women, PwBD and ex-servicemen candidates. People who applied under the earlier Advertisement No. R/NT/2025/01 must apply again online, but pay no fee if they upload the receipt for the fee already paid.

Applications are made online by 30 November 2026. A hard copy of the online form with self-attested documents must then reach the Assistant Registrar (Recruitment Cell) at the university by Speed Post or Registered Post by 6 pm on 7 December 2026. Incomplete applications will be rejected.
